description: The pie chart, labeled "(a) Video type distribution," illustrates the proportional breakdown of various video categories within a dataset, divided into 14 distinct slices. Starting from the top right and moving clockwise, the categories and their corresponding percentages are: People Blogs in orange (17.2%), Music in purple (2.3%), Autos Vehicles in red (4.8%), Pets Animals in green (3.9%), News Politics in brownish-orange (4.3%), Science Technology in blue (6.4%), Comedy in light blue (5.6%), Travel Events in yellowish-green (4.6%), Gaming in grey (6.4%), Sports in pink (7.7%), Film Animation in brown (4.6%), Entertainment in light purple (13.9%), Education in coral red (8.7%), and Howto Style in dark green (9.7%). The chart does not utilize a separate legend; rather, the category labels are placed immediately outside the perimeter of the chart next to their respective slices, with the percentage values displayed directly inside each colored segment. There are no visually emphasized slices, such as exploded or offset segments, and the categories do not appear to be ordered by size in either an ascending or descending manner.
